# Sigil

> Sigil is an MCP Apps server (npm: @real-case/sigil) that renders live, interactive chart widgets inline in MCP Apps hosts such as Claude Desktop, Claude web and VS Code Copilot Chat. Each tool takes JSON arguments validated by a zod schema and returns a UI resource the host mounts in a sandboxed iframe.

## Install

- Claude Desktop / VS Code: run over stdio with `npx -y @real-case/sigil` (see the README for the config snippet).
- Claude web: run the HTTP server (`npm run dev`, port 3001) behind an HTTPS tunnel or proxy and add the `/mcp` URL as a custom connector.

## Tools

- render_bar_chart: comparing discrete categories and rankings
- render_line_chart: time series, trends, continuous data
- render_pie_chart: part-of-whole proportions
- render_table: sortable, filterable rows with optional sparkline columns
- render_scatter_chart: relationships and clusters between two measures
- render_treemap: hierarchical part-of-whole
- render_heatmap: intensity across two categorical axes
- render_stat_panel: KPI and scorecard cards with trends and targets
- render_sankey: flows from source to destination
- render_dashboard: a grid of tiles, each tile any other widget
- render_map: world or US-state choropleth and bubble maps
